name: waitlist

frames.best_why: Shows the full section with a filled email, all three stat tiles, the avatar row and the joined count.

tagline: Collect early-access emails under a drifting pink spotlight and particle field.
summary: A centred early-access page with a badge, large gradient headline, three stat tiles, an email field and a pink Join button. Submitting swaps the form for a thank-you pill, with avatars and a joined count below.
appearance: A dark full-width page lit by soft pink diagonal spotlights and drifting white dots. A pale badge sits above a big Join the Waitlist headline, then three bordered stat tiles, an email field and a pink button, with a small avatar row below.
behaviour: Content fades up on load while the spotlights drift and particles react to the pointer. Submitting the email briefly shows Joining then replaces the field and button with a glowing thank-you pill.
demo_content: Join the Waitlist for Halcyon, stats 100+ Components / Open Source / Premium, 2,400+ joined
search_phrases: email capture page for a launch
dark landing page with pink glow
use_when: A product or feature is not live yet and you need to collect early-access emails on a single page.
avoid_when: Sites that need reusable blocks: copy, stats and avatars are hardcoded and the whole page is one piece.
customise: The headline, subtitle, stats, avatar images and joined count are written into the file, so changes need source edits. Submission is simulated and spotlight gradients are internal defaults.
weight_why: A 100-particle canvas loop, two drifting spotlight layers and small entrance animations.

a11y.note: The email field relies on its placeholder with no label, every avatar repeats the alt Avatar, and the drifting spotlights ignore reduced motion.

issues: The email field has only a placeholder and no visible or programmatic label.
Submission is simulated with a timeout, so no email is sent until the host wires it up.
polish_why: Layered spotlights and particles give real depth; the stat row and stock avatars feel generic.
